title: Approving a line moves its Quoted inventory part to In stock
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • Signed in as an Owner or Admin, at one location [Loc-1].
  • [Part-A]: inventory part ZZAUTOTEST-SV4802-01 at [Loc-1] with 5 in stock, used only by this case.
  • [WO-1]: a work order for customer "ZZAUTOTEST SV4802 Approve Line", open on its Lines tab.
  • [Line-1]: one line on [WO-1] showing "Needs Approval", with its Approve and Decline buttons.
  • [Part-A] requested on [Line-1] from Inventory, quantity 1, showing "Quoted".
custom_steps:
1. On [WO-1], click Approve on [Line-1]. Do not refresh the page.
  2. Refresh the page.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: [Line-1] shows Approved.
  • Step 1: without any page refresh, [Part-A] changes from "Quoted" to "In stock", and its "Pick" action is shown.
  • Step 2: after the refresh, [Part-A] still shows "In stock" with the "Pick" action.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Jira SV-4802 "Inventory Part Remains in Quoted Status after Line Status Changes from Need Approval to Approved" (Bug, Done, fix version v0.43 released 11 Nov 2025; epic SV-4796 "V0.43 - Regression Testing Bugs"): Expected Result and Steps to Reproduce; developer comment (Dusan Bulovan, 5 Nov 2025) that a page refresh showed the correct status, so the fix is on screen; fix verified on staging 7 Nov 2025 (Edit Line window and bulk edit) and on production 12 Nov 2025 (Nebojsa Glavinic). Read 8 Oct 2026. Source-verified 8 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • SV-4802 Expected Result: “The inventory part status should automatically update from `Quoted` to `In stock` with action `Pick`”
  • SV-4802 Steps to Reproduce, step 3: “Change the line status to `Approved`/`Authorized`”
  • SV-4802 comment, Dusan Bulovan, 5 Nov 2025: “Also, page refresh gives the correct part status, which is usually an indicator of FE issue.”

AUTOMATION: HOLD - not yet build-verified
